_notes: The stop lands inside the 3rd onEvent; the next frame is a JSON-RPC error, so the SDK throws before the pump can see the signal, and the turn ends in runAgentTurn's catch with the signal already aborted.

Phase 1 (review finding S1): result.parts keeps what streamed ('First, checking the ') beside the error. Before, the catch returned empty parts, and streamToAgent — which treats an aborted result as a stop and saves its parts — saved nothing, so done's refetch cleared text the user had watched arrive.
No session upsert and no taskState, as for stream_rpc_error: the catch returns before the session write. A non-aborted failure still returns no parts (stream_rpc_error).
